name: The Hero of Solfernum
source:
Graduating soon, William Carter dreams of a story that’ll make his name. But when a ghostly bus carries him to Solfernum – a twisted mirror of reality filled with witches and blood-soaked rituals – he must confront darkness and his own heart. Every decision could cost him dearly.
